_note: SYNTHETIC DATA — sample data converted from WestJet_Enterprise_Control_Tower_Input_Template.xlsx. KPI values are computed by the Python KPI engine; scenario values are SIMULATED, not actual performance.

S001.label: S001 Fuel Shock
assumptions: Fuel Price +20%: Fuel Cost scaled by 1.20 -> Operating Cost up -> CASM up -> Margin down.

S002.label: S002 Demand Upside
assumptions: Passenger Demand +10%: Passengers, RPM, Passenger Revenue and Ancillary Revenue scaled by 1.10 (yield held constant).

S003.label: S003 Demand Downside
assumptions: Passenger Demand -10%: Passengers, RPM, Passenger Revenue and Ancillary Revenue scaled by 0.90 (yield held constant).

S004.label: S004 Capacity Growth
assumptions: Capacity +8%: ASM, Block Hours, Fuel Cost and Other Operating Cost scaled by 1.08.

S005.label: S005 Maintenance Inflation
assumptions: Maintenance Cost +12%: Operating Cost up by $3,253,895 (maintenance treated as part of Operating Cost).

S006.label: S006 Labour Inflation
assumptions: Labour Cost +7%: Operating Cost up by $477,891,058.

S007.label: S007 Yield Improvement
assumptions: Yield +5%: Passenger Revenue scaled by 1.05 (RPM unchanged).

S008.label: S008 Ancillary Upside
assumptions: Ancillary Revenue +10%: Ancillary Revenue scaled by 1.10.

S009.label: S009 Cancellation Shock
assumptions: Cancellations +15%: Departures fall to 1,145,361; Passengers, RPM and Passenger Revenue scaled by 0.998.
